Bénéfices : Mitochondria - Supports healthy cellular energy production†
Weight - Supports your body's natural metabolic processes†
Joints - Helps maintain joint comfort and flexibility†
Energy - Supports steady, sustained energy throughout the day†          Your Cells Need Support. Auniva Starts at the Source.

Modern life places constant strain on your body. Stress, processed foods, poor sleep, and environmental factors can all take a toll on your cells over time, making it harder for your body to function the way it should.†

Auniva uses a standardised extract of amla, traditionally known as "The Nurse Fruit," to support cellular energy pathways and help maintain healthy mitochondrial function at the core.†

Cellular First: Formulated to support the body at the cellular level†
Single Ingredient: 100% pure amla extract, no blends or fillers
Verified Quality: Made in the USA and third-party tested for purity     The Results-
A Complete 90-Day Cellular Support Cycle.

Auniva is designed to work with the body's natural timelines, supporting gradual cellular wellness rather than short-term fixes.†

Weeks 1–2: Many users report noticing improvements in sleep quality and daily rhythm*
Weeks 3–4: Users often experience increased comfort and balance as part of their daily routine*
Weeks 6+: With consistent use, users may notice broader improvements in how they feel day to day*

Composition : Actif : 1000 mg de poudre de fruit d'amla (Phyllanthus emblica) par portion de 2 gélules. Excipients : gélule végétale (HPMC), farine de riz brun, stéarate de magnésium. 60 gélules = 30 jours. Confirmé par l'utilisateur le 2026-11-08 : poudre + excipients, pas un extrait standardisé.

Utilisation : Take 2 capsules daily with water, ideally in the morning.‡ Taking Auniva consistently helps support cellular and mitochondrial pathways over time.† Regular daily use is key.
